summary: A future on NFO with open interest: a Quote client, then a Depth client (ModeChange to DEPTH), whose DepthTick serves both; the Depth client leaves (ModeChange back to QUOTE) and the next QuoteTick reaches the Quote client only; the last one leaves (Unsubscribe).

deviations.reason: web pads each side to five rows of price 0.0 (sahi_mapping.py::_depth_side); docs: buy/sell are the broker's levels; never invent zero prices (decisions.md). The padding is the adapter's own: Sahi's DepthTick carries only the levels holding orders, as repeated best_buys (field 11) and best_sells (field 12) entries with no fixed empty slots (sahi_proto.py:228-231; sahi_mapping.py:99). The desktop keeps every level Sahi sent, up to five.
